name: lurker-drops
description: Chrome extension that keeps selected tabs watching a matching Twitch live.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:background && npm run build:content
scripts.build:content: esbuild src/content/chat-hook.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome116 --outfile=dist/chat-hook.js && esbuild src/content/chat-monitor.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome116 --outfile=dist/chat-monitor.js && esbuild src/content/lurker-overlay.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome116 --outfile=dist/lurker-overlay.js
